question: Which Indian shooter won two Paralympic medals in the single edition of Paralympic on 3 September 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Avani Lekhara.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Avani Lekhara, an Indian shooter, won two Paralympic medals in the single edition of the Paralympic on 3 September 2021.**
 
• Avani Lekhara won bronze in the women's 50m rifle 3 positions SH1 event with a score of 445.9 to become the first Indian woman to win two medals at the Paralympics.
 
• China's Zhang Cuiping won gold with a Paralympic Record score of 457.9,
